claims.evidence: Witness photos show visible wear/scratches, paint fading, and surface rust/scuffs on the metal body.

risks.risk: Motor/electrical condition unknown (may not power on, may run poorly, or speed control may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powering on and running while stitching (or at least running with the foot pedal), showing smooth motion and stable speed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified working condition (assume may need service/repair).

risks.risk: Internal timing/bobbin area unknown (may have incorrect timing, bobbin case issues, or inconsistent stitches).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the bobbin/bobbin case area and needle/timing area (inside view), plus a close-up of stitches produced on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing internal servicing (worst-case for stitch quality).

risks.risk: Accessories/completeness unknown (foot pedal, power cable, presser feet, bobbins, needles, attachments may be missing).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included accessory (foot pedal, power cable, presser feet set, bobbins, needles, any attachments) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case missing key parts).

risks.risk: Belts/wiring/switch condition unknown (belt may be worn, wiring unsafe, switch faulty).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the belt/pulley area and wiring/power switch, plus a clip showing safe operation when powered.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing inspection for belts/wiring/switch.

risks.risk: Brand/model and parts compatibility unknown (no readable nameplate; harder to source parts).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/brand/model label (straight-on, readable), or a close-up of any stamped identifiers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/unknown model (higher risk for parts availability).

proof_requests: Video: power on + foot pedal test showing smooth running (no unusual noise/smell) and stable speed.
Video or photos: stitch test on fabric showing consistent stitches.
Clear inside photos: bobbin case/bobbin area and needle/timing area.
Photo of all included accessories laid out with counts (foot pedal, power cable, presser feet, bobbins, needles, attachments).
Close-up photos of belt/pulley area and the power switch/wiring.
Clear, readable photo of the brand/model nameplate (or any stamped identifiers).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a vintage-style sewing machine and the photos show cosmetic wear (scratches/paint fading/rust), so a worst-case price can be set despite the seller’s “perfect condition” claim being contradicted.
